definition: The angle at the centre of a circle when the arc between the two radii is as long as the radius; $\pi$ radians $= 180^{\circ}$.
The part of a circle's circumference between two points on it.
The region of a circle between two radii and the arc joining their ends; the smaller one is the minor sector and the larger one the major sector.
A straight line segment joining two points on a circle.
The region between a chord of a circle and the arc it cuts off.
